newsitem.title: USA: Owosso sees Q4 below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Owosso sees Q4 below estimates.

text.p: Owosso Corp said on Monday that it expects its fourth quarter results for the period ending October 27, 1996, to be below analysts' current estimates of $0.06 to $0.10 a share.
Last year, Owosso reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.22 a share on sales of $30.1 million.

Owosso said lower margins in its trailer business, production difficulties in its agricultural equipment businesses and the costs of reducing production at its Owosso, Michigan motor facility have put pressure on results.
In fiscal 1997, Owosso said it intends to move production of sub-assemblies made by Owosso's Dew Eze subsidiary to its Great Bend Manufacturing subsidiary, where costs are expected to be lower.
The Michigan motor facility has absorbed most of the costs of scaling back production and it anticipates resuming higher production levels in 1997, Owosso said.

Owosso, which plans to report its earnings on December 5, said it expects a planned inventory reduction program at its heat transfer coil business and will lead to a larger than anticipated loss in that operation for the quarter.
It also expects a higher effective tax rate because of the relatively high level of non-deductible expenses, Owosso said.
With the exception of the sub-assembly production, the company does not expect these issues to affect fiscal 1997 results, Owosso said.
